purpose: Establish the source-custody baseline for the dedicated $TRUMP empirical reconstruction without yet asserting manipulation, motive, insider activity, or quid pro quo.

observations.official_product_claim: The site identifies the product as the only official Trump meme and as a product associated with President Donald J. Trump.
observations.affiliate_ownership_statement: CIC Digital LLC, an affiliate of The Trump Organization, and Fight Fight Fight LLC collectively own 80% of the Trump Cards, subject to a 3-year unlocking schedule.
observations.trading_revenue_statement: The site states that CIC Digital LLC and Celebration Cards LLC, the owner of Fight Fight Fight LLC, receive trading revenue derived from trading activities of Trump Meme Cards.
observations.purchase_path_statement: The official site directs buyers to acquire SOL and use Raydium to swap for $TRUMP; it also references Moonshot and Solana/USDC purchase paths.
observations.investment_disclaimer: The site states that Trump Memes are expressions of support/engagement and are not intended as an investment opportunity, investment contract, or security.

launch_promotion_source.observed_content_summary: Donald Trump announced his new official Trump meme, told readers to join his Trump community, directed them to get $TRUMP, and linked gettrumpmemes.com.
launch_promotion_source.custody_note: This archive is not the platform-of-origin primary source. The Truth Social status ID and original URL must still be captured directly or through a platform-preserving archival source before the event timestamp is promoted to authoritative custody.

independent_reporting_leads.use: independent reporting on launch, ownership concentration, ethical/conflict questions, and early valuation; not a substitute for on-chain reconstruction
independent evidence of immediate financial-market product interest after launch

hypothesis_relevant_observations_without: The official structure directly links trading activity to revenue for identified affiliated entities, so trading volume is an economically relevant dependent variable even if token price later falls.
The official launch path required or encouraged acquisition/use of SOL for Raydium swaps, creating a testable spillover channel into Solana demand around launch.
The concentrated affiliate allocation and three-year unlock schedule make inventory value, unlock timing, and liquidity management necessary components of any beneficiary analysis.
None of these structural facts establishes manipulation, improper intent, or any unlawful conduct.

capture the original Truth Social launch object with platform-origin timestamp if accessible
